title: Platform Auth Claims
description: Canonical LiNKplatform authentication claim object (platform.auth-claims/1.1.0). CamelCase only; additionalProperties false. orgId may be null only when actorKind is service.

actorKind.description: Actor kind; transient sessions are not actors

runtimeBindingId.description: Runtime/installation binding that issued or presents these claims

orgId.description: Organisation association; null only when actorKind is service (Platform-global service principals)

internal.description: Whether the actor is an internal Platform/service principal

serviceScopes.description: Service scopes this credential may enter (e.g. lbrain, lskills, linkplatform)

permittedOperations.description: Operations permitted within the granted scopes

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 expiry timestamp; claims are rejected at or after this instant

issuer.description: Platform issuer identity that minted the claims

audience.description: Intended audiences (API/service names) that may accept these claims

programRestrictions.description: Optional Program ID allow-list; omit or null when unrestricted at claim layer

repositoryRestrictions.description: Optional repository allow-list; omit or null when unrestricted at claim layer

correlationId.description: Opaque request/correlation ID; must not carry domain payloads
